record.context_brief: existence for prescribed H and planar boundary
record.original_question: Let C be a simple planar closed curve of length L, and let D be the planar domain bounded by C. For every H in the interval [0, L/(2|D|)], does there exist a compact surface of constant mean curvature H bounded by C? In particular, what happens when C is convex or when C is an ellipse?

evidence.quote: For example, suppose that C is a simple closed curve contained in a plane P and let D be the bounded domain by C in P. Then max{|A_v| : |v| = 1} is attained when v is orthogonal to P and its value is the area of D. Therefore |H| <= L/(2|D|).

Problem 3.1 (3*). Let C be a simple planar closed curve. Is there an H-surface bounded by C for each H of the interval [0, L/(2|D|)]? Particularize to the case that C is a convex curve or C is an ellipse.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a simple closed curve of length $L$ contained in a plane $P$, and let $D \subset P$ denote the bounded planar domain whose boundary is $C$, with area $|D|$. An $H$-surface bounded by $C$ is a compact, connected, oriented immersed surface $\Sigma \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ with constant mean curvature equal to $H$ whose boundary $\partial \Sigma$ equals $C$. A standard flux/area argument shows that if such an $H$-surface exists, then $|H| \le L/(2|D|)$.

(a) Prove or disprove: for every $H \in [0,\, L/(2|D|)]$ there exists an $H$-surface bounded by $C$.

(b) Resolve the same question under the additional assumption that $C$ is a convex planar curve.

(c) Resolve the same question in the special case that $C$ is an ellipse.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature contains structure and uniqueness theorems for compact CMC surfaces with planar boundary (e.g. Barbosa, Brito–Earp–Meeks–Rosenberg, and results for pseudo-elliptic boundaries showing convexity of such surfaces), but no general existence theorem covering the full range $H \in [0, L/(2|D|)]$ for arbitrary simple planar boundary curves was found, and the problem appears unresolved even for ellipses.

status_evidence.title: Surfaces with constant mean curvature in Euclidean space (López)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses compact CMC surfaces with prescribed planar boundary and the bound |H| ≤ L/(2|D|), with existence questions still discussed as open in general.
status_evidence.claim: Existence for the full interval up to the optimal bound is not established in the surveyed literature.

status_evidence.title: The topology and geometry of embedded surfaces of constant mean curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Structure results for CMC surfaces with planar boundary, but not a general existence theorem for all admissible H.
status_evidence.claim: Known structural results do not resolve the existence question.
